allOf.x-docs-internal: This object also takes all keys of the root values, for example `workload`, `service` and `persistence`. They come from the Helm subchart dependency that defines this object: Helm adds the default values of the subchart here. Do not set them in the values of the chart.

enabled.description: Enables the Solr dependency. Supports Helm `tpl`.

includeCommon.description: Marker for charts that the dependency uses common. Not read by common.

solrUsername.description: Name of the admin user, used in the connection URL and the wait container.

solrCores.description: Name or number of the core used in the connection URL and the wait container.

solrEnableAuthentication.description: Whether the wait container authenticates with `solrUsername` and the password.

creds.description: Connection details written by common, so apps using the dependency can use them. Read only.

description: Solr dependency configuration. The root values keys are also accepted, as the content of the Helm subchart that defines this dependency.
